803-4823-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-4823-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4518-4924--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Heartless Summoning.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-4924--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

728-7084-8338.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1778-3899-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-3899-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Memnite, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

225-2577-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-3899-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-2738-4871-5687.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

824-2292-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2292-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2292-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4365-4772-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
4365-4772-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3375-4399-4518-6097.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

5086-5183-5231-6441-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6441-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2104-4013-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Eldrazi Displacer.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

206-222-527-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2099-2906-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2099-2906-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1069-1169-1374-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1169-1374-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

628-2292-7217.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-6594-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6594-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

562-2034-3169-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Warrior en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2440-3399-4399-4506.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Auriok Champion triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

3490-4050-7080.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
Sandbender Scavengers triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-6797-6972--112.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
284-6797-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1987-2103-4423-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2103-4423-6991.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-4364-4826-6332.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2034-4364-4826-6332.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Terra's first ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Declare Terra and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Terra, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Aurelia, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Terra ability, choosing to pay {2} to trigger its reflexive ability, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat each combat phase.

972-2239-3542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2239-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist and the Palinchron token.
When the Ardent Elementalist and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2239-3542.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Ardent Elementalist instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

323-2173-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

465-3499-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

813-2417-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Siren's Ruse.
813-2417-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2577-4871-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-4871-5686.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

413-2091-2239-4558.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least nine tapped lands.
413-2091-2239-4558.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ardent Elementalist.
Repeat.

372-1809-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-2719-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-2719-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

277-4974-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-4974-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1283-2821-4235.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Minamo's ability, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve both Minamo abilities, untapping it and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other permanent using Minamo's ability, or you may use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards if you control a colored permanent.

1020-2866-2906-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
1020-2866-2906-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1644-1669-3505-4423-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Plains.
Archelos is untapped.
1644-1669-3505-4423-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Thaumatog's first ability three times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains, giving Thaumatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all land cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Tatyova triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

803-997-4338.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

232-4316-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Urabrask on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

927-4741.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, causing an opponent who controls no Islands to gain control of Merchant Ship.
Merchant Ship triggers, causing the opponent to sacrifice it.
However, Merchant Ship cannot be sacrificed due to its ability granted by Jon Irenicus.
Merchant Ship triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

538-2397-3977-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary and Impact Tremors trigger twice each.
Resolve both Burning-Tree Emissary triggers, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve both Impact Tremors triggers, deals 2 damage to each opponent.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {R}{G}.
Horned Kavu and Impact Tremors trigger twice each.
Resolve both Horned Kavu triggers, returning Horned Kavu and Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand.
Resolve both Impact Tremors triggers, deals 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1636-3209.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
1636-3209.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping five untapped creatures you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

614-1987-2427-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
